sentences.en: Three little pigs lived with their mother.
sentences.tgt: Trois:o petits:a cochons:n vivaient:v avec:o leur:o mère:n .:o

sentences.en: They lived in a small home in the woods.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o vivaient:v dans:o une:o petite:a maison:n dans:o les:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: One day, their mother called the three pigs.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o leur:o mère:n appela:v les:o trois:o cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: "You are big pigs now," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o êtes:v de:o grands:a cochons:n maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "Go and build houses of your own," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Allez:v construire:v vos:o propres:a maisons:n ,:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "But watch out for the wolf!" she called.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o faites:v attention:n au:o loup:n !:o »:o cria:v -t-elle:o .:o

sentences.en: A wolf lived deep in the woods.
sentences.tgt: Un:o loup:n vivait:v au:o fond:n des:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf liked to eat little pigs.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n aimait:v manger:v de:o petits:a cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: The three pigs said goodbye to their mother.
sentences.tgt: Les:o trois:o cochons:n dirent:v au:o revoir:n à:o leur:o mère:n .:o

sentences.en: They left home to build their own houses.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o quittèrent:v la:o maison:n pour:o construire:v leurs:o propres:a maisons:n .:o

sentences.en: Each pig went a different way.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o cochon:n prit:v un:o chemin:n différent:a .:o

sentences.en: The first pig found a pile of straw.
sentences.tgt: Le:o premier:a cochon:n trouva:v un:o tas:n de:o paille:n .:o

sentences.en: He built a house of straw in one day.
sentences.tgt: Il:o construisit:v une:o maison:n de:o paille:n en:o un:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: "Now I can play all day," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Maintenant:a je:o peux:v jouer:v toute:o la:o journée:n »:o ,:o dit-il:o .:o

sentences.en: The second pig found sticks in the woods.
sentences.tgt: Le:o deuxième:o cochon:n trouva:v des:o bâtons:n dans:o les:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: He built a house of sticks in two days.
sentences.tgt: Il:o construisit:v une:o maison:n de:o bâtons:n en:o deux:o jours:n .:o

sentences.en: The stick house was stronger than the straw house.
sentences.tgt: La:o maison:n de:o bâtons:n était:v plus:a solide:a que:o la:o maison:n de:o paille:n .:o

sentences.en: The third pig remembered the wolf.
sentences.tgt: Le:o troisième:o cochon:n se:o souvint:v du:o loup:n .:o

sentences.en: He wanted a strong house, so he gathered many bricks.
sentences.tgt: Il:o voulait:v une:o maison:n solide:a ,:o alors:o il:o rassembla:v beaucoup:a de:o briques:n .:o

sentences.en: The bricks were heavy and slow to carry.
sentences.tgt: Les:o briques:n étaient:v lourdes:a et:o lentes:a à:o porter:v .:o

sentences.en: The brick house took many days to build.
sentences.tgt: La:o maison:n de:o briques:n prit:v beaucoup:a de:o jours:n à:o construire:v .:o

sentences.en: But the third pig was tired and did not stop.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o troisième:o cochon:n était:v fatigué:a et:o ne:o s':o arrêta:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: At last, the brick house was done.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a ,:o la:o maison:n de:o briques:n était:v terminée:a .:o

sentences.chapter: The Wolf and the Straw House
sentences.en: Soon, the wolf was hungry.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a ,:o le:o loup:n avait:v faim:n .:o

sentences.en: He went to find the three pigs.
sentences.tgt: Il:o partit:v chercher:v les:o trois:o cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf found the house of straw.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n trouva:v la:o maison:n de:o paille:n .:o

sentences.en: He knocked on the door.
sentences.tgt: Il:o frappa:v à:o la:o porte:n .:o

sentences.en: "Little pig, let me come in!" called the wolf.
sentences.tgt: «:o Petit:a cochon:n ,:o laisse:v -moi:o entrer:v !:o »:o cria:v le:o loup:n .:o

sentences.en: "No, I won't let you in!" said the first pig.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o je:o ne:o te:o laisserai:v pas:o entrer:v !:o »:o dit:v le:o premier:a cochon:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf huffed.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n souffla:v fort:a .:o

sentences.en: The wolf puffed.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n souffla:v encore:a .:o

sentences.en: The straw house fell down.
sentences.tgt: La:o maison:n de:o paille:n s':o effondra:v .:o

sentences.en: The first pig ran to the second pig's house.
sentences.tgt: Le:o premier:a cochon:n courut:v vers:o la:o maison:n du:o deuxième:a cochon:n .:o

sentences.en: He was safe inside the stick house.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v en:o sécurité:n à:o l':o intérieur:n de:o la:o maison:n de:o bâtons:n .:o

sentences.chapter: The Wolf and the Stick House
sentences.en: The wolf was still hungry.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n avait:v encore:a faim:n .:o

sentences.en: He went to find the pigs.
sentences.tgt: Il:o alla:v trouver:v les:o cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon, the wolf found the stick house.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a ,:o le:o loup:n trouva:v la:o maison:n de:o bâtons:n .:o

sentences.en: Two little pigs were inside.
sentences.tgt: Deux:o petits:a cochons:n étaient:v à:o l':o intérieur:n .:o

sentences.en: "Little pigs, let me come in!" called the wolf.
sentences.tgt: «:o Petits:a cochons:n ,:o laissez-moi:v entrer:v !:o »:o cria:v le:o loup:n .:o

sentences.en: "No, we won't let you in!" said the pigs.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o nous:o ne:o vous:o laisserons:v pas:o entrer:v !:o »:o dirent:v les:o cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: "I'll huff and puff and blow your house down!"
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v souffler:v et:o encore:a souffler:v et:o faire:v tomber:v votre:o maison:n !:o »:o

sentences.en: The wolf huffed and puffed hard.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n souffla:v très:a fort:a .:o

sentences.en: This time, the house did not fall fast.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o fois:n ,:o la:o maison:n ne:o tomba:v pas:o vite:a .:o

sentences.en: But the stick house fell down too.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o la:o maison:n de:o bâtons:n tomba:v aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: Both pigs ran to the third pig's house.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o cochons:n coururent:v vers:o la:o maison:n du:o troisième:o cochon:n .:o

sentences.en: They were safe inside the brick house.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o étaient:v en:o sécurité:n à:o l':o intérieur:n de:o la:o maison:n de:o briques:n .:o

sentences.chapter: The Wolf and the Brick House
sentences.en: All three pigs were inside the brick house.
sentences.tgt: Les:o trois:o cochons:n étaient:v tous:o à:o l':o intérieur:n de:o la:o maison:n de:o briques:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf found them.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n les:o trouva:v .:o

sentences.en: "Little pigs, let me come in!" called the wolf.
sentences.tgt: «:o Petits:a cochons:n ,:o laissez:v -moi:o entrer:v !:o »:o cria:v le:o loup:n .:o

sentences.en: "No, we won't let you in!" said the pigs.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o nous:o ne:o vous:o laisserons:v pas:o entrer:v !:o »:o dirent:v les:o cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: "I'll huff and puff and blow your house down!"

sentences.en: The wolf huffed and puffed hard.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n souffla:v et:o souffla:v fort:a .:o

sentences.en: But the brick house did not move.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o la:o maison:n de:o briques:n ne:o bougea:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: The wolf huffed and puffed.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n souffla:v et:o souffla:v .:o

sentences.en: Still, the house did not fall.
sentences.tgt: Pourtant:o ,:o la:o maison:n ne:o tomba:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: The wolf stopped to rest.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n s':o arrêta:v pour:o se:o reposer:v .:o

sentences.en: He wanted another way into the house.
sentences.tgt: Il:o voulait:v une:o autre:a façon:n d':o entrer:v dans:o la:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf saw the chimney on the roof.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n vit:v la:o cheminée:n sur:o le:o toit:n .:o

sentences.en: The wolf climbed up onto the roof.

sentences.en: The third pig heard him up there.
sentences.tgt: Le:o troisième:a cochon:n l':o entendit:v là-haut:a .:o

sentences.en: "He will come down the chimney," said the third pig.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o descendra:v par:o la:o cheminée:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o troisième:a cochon:n .:o

sentences.en: The third pig heated a pot of water.
sentences.tgt: Le:o troisième:a cochon:n chauffa:v une:o marmite:n d':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon, the water in the pot was hot.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a ,:o l':o eau:n dans:o la:o marmite:n était:v chaude:a .:o

sentences.en: The wolf climbed down the dark chimney.

sentences.en: Splash!

sentences.en: The wolf fell into the hot water.

sentences.en: He jumped out with a yelp.

sentences.en: The wolf ran out through the door.
sentences.tgt: Le:o loup:n sortit:v en:o courant:v par:o la:o porte:n .:o

sentences.en: He ran into the woods and never came back.
sentences.tgt: Il:o courut:v dans:o les:o bois:n et:o ne:o revint:v jamais:o .:o

sentences.en: Now the three pigs were safe forever.
sentences.tgt: Désormais:a ,:o les:o trois:o cochons:n étaient:v en:o sécurité:n pour:o toujours:a .:o
